wins.label: Organizational Simplification
wins.evidence: The simplification of our organization structure will conclude at the end of the first quarter and will result in over $1 billion of run rate saves from the net elimination of approximately 5,000 roles mainly managers.

wins.label: Strategic Divestitures
wins.evidence: We have now completed the divestitures of 9 of our 14 international consumer franchises and have wound down nearly 70% of our total retail loans and deposits in Russia, Korea and China.

wins.label: Technology Investments
wins.evidence: In total, we invested over $12 billion in technology in 2023. Beyond transformation, our technology investments are also focused on digital innovation, new product development, client experience enhancements and areas that support our infrastructure like cloud and cyber.

wins.label: Client Wins
wins.evidence: We've now gained over 100 basis points in share in security services since 2021. In wealth, we added an estimated $21 billion in net new assets during the year.

wins.label: Expense Management
wins.evidence: We met our full year expense guidance, and we increased our CET1 ratio to 13.3% during the year.

risks.label: External Headwinds
risks.evidence: Earlier this week, we disclosed additional external headwinds, some of which materialized in the second half of December, including a $1.3 billion reserve build related to transfer risk stemming from exposures to Argentina and Russia.

risks.label: Market Volatility
risks.evidence: Markets revenues decreased 6% to $18.9 billion, largely driven by lower volatility and a significant slowdown in December.

risks.label: Wealth Performance
risks.evidence: Wealth revenues decreased 5% to $7.1 billion, primarily due to the deposit mix shift towards higher-yielding products, which drove lower deposit spreads.

risks.label: Credit Risks
risks.evidence: The reserve build of $1.3 billion related to increases in transfer risk associated with exposures to Russia and Argentina as described in the 8-K.

risks.label: Regulatory Challenges
risks.evidence: We were pleased to have closed the FX consent order with the Federal Reserve. We're committed to fulfilling the expectations of our regulators, given the unique role we play in the global financial system.

wins.label: Record TTS Client Wins
wins.evidence: Client wins up 27% and a sustained win-loss rate above 80%.

wins.label: Significant Share Gain in Security Services
wins.evidence: Gained over 100 basis points in share in security services since 2021.

wins.label: Record Year for Services Revenue
wins.evidence: Services revenues were up 16% for the full year despite the impact of the Argentine devaluation.

wins.label: USPB Growth
wins.evidence: Enjoyed our sixth consecutive quarter of growth, and we began to see the early fruits of our investments in key talent in banking.

wins.label: Wealth Assets Growth
wins.evidence: Added an estimated $21 billion in net new assets during the year.

risks.label: Argentina Devaluation Impact
risks.evidence: A $1.3 billion reserve build related to transfer risk stemming from exposures to Argentina and Russia. A nearly $900 million negative revenue impact as a result of the larger-than-expected devaluation of the Argentine currency.

risks.label: FDIC Assessment
risks.evidence: An FDIC special assessment of approximately $1.7 billion related to regional bank failures in March.

risks.label: Rate Environment Uncertainty
risks.evidence: Expects growth slowing globally with the U.S. well positioned with sand or run-of-the-mill recession should one materialize.

risks.label: NCL Rate Increases
risks.evidence: NCL rates have reached pre-COVID levels, but we continue to be well reserved with a reserve to funded loan ratio of 2.7%.

risks.label: Market Volatility
risks.evidence: Markets was also impacted by the Argentine devaluation. Fixed income results were disappointing as we saw a significant slowdown in December, particularly in rates and FX.
